title: Ongoing notification wakes up display every 5 minutes.
symptom: The ongoing notification from xDrip wakes up the display every 5 minutes on a Google Pixel XL with Android 10, unless the notification is set to 'silent' in Android settings. The user wants to keep the notification visible at the top without waking the display.
cause: The issue is likely due to Android phone settings, such as 'wake screen for notifications' under Display -> Lock Screen settings, rather than an xDrip issue.
fix: Turn off 'wake screen for notifications' under Display -> Lock Screen settings on the phone. Alternatively, set the xDrip notification to 'silent' or disable floating notifications and lock screen notifications for the specific notification channel.
evidence_quote: Maybe it's actually an Android setting. I have "wake screen for notifications" turned on under "Display" -> "Lock Screen" settings. I'll try turning it off and waiting to see if that changes the behavior.
